QF.id: Duplicate Share Certificates and Transmission of Securities_1

question.text: Rajesh lost his physical share certificates worth Rs.3 lakhs. Under SEBI's framework, which document requirement is waived for issuing duplicate certificates when the value of securities does not exceed Rs.5 lakhs?

answer.text: Indemnity bond and affidavit in the prescribed format
Application to the RTA regarding loss
Stop transfer marking on the lost securities

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.155, the requirements of filing an FIR/e-FIR/police complaint and publishing a newspaper advertisement are not applicable if the value of the securities as on the date of application does not exceed Rs.5 lakhs. Other documents (intimation/application, stop-transfer marking, and affidavit/indemnity in the prescribed format) remain required. The Trap: Intimation/application, stop-transfer marking, and the affidavit/indemnity bond requirement (pp.154-155 and the duplicate-certificate SOP on p.166) are not waived by the Rs.5 lakh threshold. Note: The affidavit and indemnity should be in the prescribed format under the SEBI duplicate-certificate framework, rather than relying on any single attestation mode being treated as universally mandatory.
